boundary: The PATH string changes the host recall-dispatch fingerprint and generated library name/path. Recorded compiler commands, compiler/tools, 314 source/dependency hashes and every bound local native library byte are equal across these two checks, independently reread from current files. This establishes native file identity for these libraries, not complete runtime execution identity: model/profiler sources and graph policy differ. It does not isolate the causal contribution to elapsed-time differences between separate runs.
